description: Narrow runtime patches for the CanvasEngine defects every RPGJS 5 game meets: the viewport clamp, teardown before mount, and late sprite work.
rules: Call installCanvasEnginePatches({ Sprite, Viewport }) once, before CanvasEngine mounts a scene.
Pass the Sprite and Viewport factories in; the package never imports canvasengine.
A patch is kept only while a test against the real CanvasEngine class reproduces its defect.
The returned report says which patches the installed release no longer needs.
